_status: SEED — 10 MATH 210 rows hand-supplied by Sam (2026-06-11) from the c-id.net approved-courses table. Awaiting the full per-descriptor export for the 20 MATH descriptors (then statewide). Schema below is the ingestion contract.
_source: https://c-id.net — ASCCC C-ID 'Approved Courses' per descriptor (the official per-college articulation record, incl. approval terms). NOT reachable from session containers (403) — exports are curator-supplied.
_schema: articulations[]: {cid, cid_title, college, subject, number, local_title, approval_term}. Join key is (college, subject, number) against the raw COCI list — EXACT match (leading-zero-normalized fallback is flagged); titles are NEVER used for joining (the whole point of this authority is that it bypasses titles).
_semantics: PRESENT-TENSE official authority at the (college, course) grain — same trust tier as COCI's own CIDNumber column, and richer (colleges under-report in COCI: in the seed, 5 of 10 approved articulations carry NO CIDNumber in COCI). Not a receipt about a historical family — no kinship gate applies. Entries that match no current COCI course (renumbered since approval) surface in the joiner's unmatched report for curation; never fuzzy-matched.
